what: spatially blocked CV folds for flood per road; development data only (226 train + val tiles, 1,037 touched roads); no model fitted or scored
method: Roberts et al. 2017, Ecography 40(8) 913-929: block CV, blocks larger than the dependence range, optional buffer
why: merging the 63 grid blocks that share a road id leaves 4 blocks, the largest holding 524 of 1037 dev roads (50.5%), > 25%, so the grid blocks are kept and each fold's training roads that share a road id with its held-out roads are purged

neighbours.neighbour rule: 8-neighbour in the same region grid, or centroids within 600 m

fold assignment: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed) over the 1,037 dev roads, groups = block, y = flooded; blocks without roads to the fold with the fewest tiles; purge relative to each fold's held-out dev roads
size-matched tile folds (control): tile_folds(over='dev') with fold k's dev training roads subsampled (default_rng(seed)) to the size of spatial fold k's dev training roads
